output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM (
  SELECT o.customer_id, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_completed_order_date
  FROM marts.fct_orders o
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
) f
WHERE f.first_completed_order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND f.first_completed_order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation:
This query counts customers whose earliest completed order falls in 2025. It finds each customer's first order with status 'completed' in marts.fct_orders, then counts the customers whose first one is dated between 1 January and 31 December 2025.

I didn't use dim_customers.first_order_date because it may include orders of any status, such as cancelled ones.

I assumed the status value is spelled exactly 'completed', but the schema doesn't list the allowed values, so that needs checking. If "completed" should mean all orders that count as revenue, swap the status filter for "o.is_revenue = true".
